title: Spider moving attacks: R2 strikes while walking, turning, climbing and chasing
desc: J on the final lair set: "we will need more extending or movement attacks from the spider to make it not just stationary". Four new R2 brute moves where every hit lands while the spider keeps moving: M1 drives you back with four jabs while walking, M2 circles you and strikes from the side, head on and on the way back, M3 climbs a 28-block cliff and stabs you over the lip mid-climb, M4 runs you down from behind. Lair rules kept and measured on every frame: legs never through the floor, each other, the body or you; every hit touches you (0 blocks).

takes.name: Drive-back combo (walking)
takes.facts: charges in, then keeps walking at 5 blocks a second while it jabs left, right, left (head), right; each hit knocks you back 4 blocks and it steps into the gap; the last throws you 6 blocks. 4 hits, all touching; 0 frames of legs through the floor, each other or you

takes.name: Circling strikes (turning)
takes.facts: circles you crabwise about 27 blocks out, facing you; darts in for a left stab to your chest, swings round head on for a right stab to your head, reverses and circles the other way for a right stab that throws you. 3 hits, all touching; 0 frames of legs through the floor, each other or you

takes.name: Climbing strike (climbing)
takes.facts: the move chart's 'climbs a wall to you': you stand on top of a 28-block cliff; R2 runs at it, climbs, stabs your legs and then your chest over the lip while still climbing, rolls over the edge and the third stab throws you. 3 hits, all touching; 0 frames of legs through the rock, each other or you

takes.name: Chase-down (you running)
takes.facts: you run at 5 blocks a second; R2 runs you down at 12, hooks your legs from behind so you fall forward, brakes, and stabs you on the floor. 2 hits, all touching; 0 frames of legs through the floor, each other or you
